_readme: Founding-era evidence for decisions.md D1-D3 (Team Europe Ventures Fund = Point Nine Capital Fund I; the founders' angel books), read 2026-09-26. Quotes as the sources give them.

facts: 'In 2008, Lukasz Gadowski ... and Kolja Hebenstreit teamed up with Pawel Chudzinski and Steffen Hoellinger to create Team Europe Ventures (TEV). TEV had two purposes: Building companies and investing in other Internet startups. Since then, TEV has founded a number of highly successful Internet companies - DeliveryHero, DigitaleSeiten, ChicChickClub, madvertise and SponsorPay'

'In 2009 TEV raised a ~EUR 6M fund, which was managed by Pawel and invested in 24 companies. 16 out of these 24 companies were co-investments with myself, some led by Pawel, some by me, some by both of us together.'

'In 2011 ... the existing TEV fund has been renamed into Point Nine Capital Fund I. The new fund, called Point Nine Capital II, is now managed by Pawel and me ... Point Nine Capital II has made four investments already - one is ... Jobber'
'from now on I'm going to make all new investments via Point Nine Capital'

'I've made 14 new investments in 2011, which brings the total number to 28. The new investments are: Lieferheld and Delivery Hero, Server Density, Fundly, Westwing, Shiftplanning, FinanceaCar, Vend, ChicChickClub, Unbounce, Cibando and 3 investments which haven[t been announced]'
'Team Europe Ventures, the investment arm of German incubator Team Europe, is being rebranded as Point Nine Capital (PNC)'
'To date, the fund ... has invested in over 10 startups, including inFakt, Lieferheld, Madvertise, MisterSpex, myGengo and SponsorPay'
'As well as being an angel investor, including working with Team Europe Ventures on a number of investments, Janz ... His investments include Zendesk, FreeAgent Central, Clio, and Propertybase'

Team Europe Ventures portfolio list: apomio GmbH, Beko Käuferportal GmbH, brands4friends, imedo GmbH, Madvertise Mobile Advertising GmbH, Mister Spex GmbH, Mymuesli GmbH, Pomocni Sp. z o.o., SponsorPay GmbH, The European Magazine
'mit ihrem ersten eigenen Fonds, der ein mittleres einstelliges Millionenvolumen erreichen soll'; 'Rund ein Dutzend Investoren haben sich bisher an dem Fonds beteiligt'
Pawel Chudzinski named as co-founder and managing director; Christoph Janz not named
Team Europe Ventures launched a new EUR 6 million fund for early stage Internet and mobile startups, seed stage, 4-5 startups per year, at most EUR 500K per company
managed from Berlin by four partners: Lukasz Gadowski, Kolja Hebenstreit, Pawel Chudzinski and Steffen Hoellinger
'The firm is currently a shareholder in 15 self founded companies or lead investments as well as 40 co-investments' (Team Europe's own book, distinct from the new fund)
'For Point Nine the adventure started in 2010, when Point Nine, operating as Team Europe Ventures Fund at the time, invested in Lieferheld's first financing round, a seed round of EUR 800k'
'In 2011, Point Nine participated in Delivery Hero's seed round and in some of its later rounds'
'Delivery Hero today accounts for about 50% of the total portfolio value of Point Nine Fund I'
sources.title: From Seed to IPO — 9 learnings by an early Delivery Hero investor

facts: 'When I did my angel investments in 2008-2011 I typically invested $50-150k per company. In some cases, I was the only investor (in case of Zendesk, for example...)'
'I was an angel investor for about three years before teaming up with Pawel to start Point Nine about eight years ago'
sources.title: 8 reasons why you shouldn’t raise a VC fund (and 4 why I love being a VC regardless)
